claim_being_audited: The actor claims the current model release should be certified now, based primarily on aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, while treating the current subgroup regression and informal monitoring note as caveated but still compatible with certification.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses are disclosed in the current release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals may be considered contextual support but cannot substitute for current-release evidence.
Informal monitoring notes may be contextual but do not satisfy reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance requirements.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification document showing current evaluation results for this release, including the cited subgroup regression.
Provide the disclosure language actually included in current-release documentation for the material segment weakness, if any.
Provide approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance records covering the subgroup regression, including owner acceptance and review status.
Provide the materiality determination for the subgroup weakness if the position is that disclosure or approved mitigation was not required.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current-release documentation to reflect current evaluation results, but the available record does not show that the current release documentation has been updated accordingly.

The policy also requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation, yet the actor summary states there is only an informal monitoring comment with no attached reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive context, but they do not resolve the missing current-release documentation predicate.
Prior approval of the same model family is stale context and cannot substitute for current-release evidence after the retrieval configuration change and new eval batch.
The actor's own summary concedes a present subgroup regression and missing formal mitigation/disclosure support, which undercuts an affirmative certification recommendation.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify the model now is not adequately supported under the stated policy because required current-release documentation and approved mitigation/disclosure support are not shown.
Any implication that prior approval plus informal monitoring is sufficient to satisfy the current-release certification standard is unsupported by the provided policy text.
Any implication that public governance guidance alone can bridge the missing release-specific disclosure or mitigation evidence is unsupported.
